label: baseline
prompt:
You are reviewing pull request #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} as a code reviewer.
The PR's head is checked out in the working directory. Its diff against the base
branch is in ${{ runner.temp }}/pr.diff; read it first, then read the surrounding
code as needed. Follow the repository's own conventions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md,
docs/ and .github/instructions/ where present).

Report only real problems a maintainer would want fixed before merging: bugs,
security issues, broken edge cases, missing or wrong tests, and clear departures
from the repository's conventions. Don't report style nits, praise, or anything
you aren't confident about. Every finding names a file path relative to the
repository root and a line number on the new side of the diff, on a line the diff
adds or shows as context, and says what is wrong and how to fix it.

Answer with a short summary of the change and your verdict, and your findings.
An empty findings list is a good answer when nothing needs fixing.

review.summary: Adds a Claude Review workflow (read-only review job plus a post job that publishes a marker-prefixed COMMENT review on the head commit), a post_claude_review.py script with tests, and PR Auto-Merge support for counting and gating on Claude reviews under the shared 3-round cap. It also fixes release_post.py container-marker whitespace and trims the CI triggers and Playwright timeout. No blocking problems found. Verdict: approve.

PR #298 adds a "Claude Review" backup reviewer for when Copilot's review doesn't arrive. It consists of:
- A label-gated `claude-review.yml` workflow. The review job runs with a read-only token and the post job has write access.
- A `post_claude_review.py` script that posts the findings as one review, with inline comments for lines in the diff and the rest in the review body under an off-diff marker.
- Changes to `pr-automerge.yml` so a marked github-actions review counts toward the review cap, its threads are tracked, and off-diff findings hold the merge.
- A `release_post.py` change that normalizes the whitespace after quote and list markers.
- A `ci.yml` change that drops the `ready_for_review` trigger and adds a 10-minute timeout to the Playwright install.

I read the diff and checked the surrounding code, including the `reviews(author: "...[bot]")` convention for Copilot and `CONTAINER_MARKER` and `after_containers` in `release_post.py`. I found no defects I'm confident about. I did not run the tests. Verdict: looks good to merge.

This PR adds a "Claude Review" backup reviewer. A read-only job runs Claude and produces structured findings. A write-scoped job then posts them as one inline COMMENT review through the new `post_claude_review.py`. Findings that fall outside the diff go in the review body under a second marker. PR Auto-Merge now counts marked `github-actions[bot]` reviews as a review round, subject to the shared review cap. It also holds on unresolved Claude threads and on off-diff findings, and it follows the "Claude Review" workflow's completion. The PR also adds tests, drops the `ready_for_review` trigger from `ci.yml`, adds a 10-minute timeout to the Playwright install, and changes `release_post.py` so spaces after container markers collapse to one. I found no real problems and read the diff only. I did not run the tests. The GraphQL `author:` filter follows the existing Copilot query, and the marker, cap and off-diff logic is consistent with its tests. Verdict: looks good to merge.
